Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Sales Lead Poland (m/f/d) Your role:

You own the Poland market on the sales side. You'll build and lead a high-performing AE & SDR team from the ground up - hiring, ramping, coaching and holding the bar on day-to-day execution.

You stay close to the front line: running deals yourself when it matters, jumping into demos and discovery calls, and setting the standard for how we sell in Poland.

You own the Polish sales number - monthly and yearly targets - and you're accountable for a reliable forecast. You work hand in hand with Marketing on lead-gen for the PL market and with Customer Success on clean handoffs.

You translate what works in DACH into the polish context, feed learnings back to the leadership team, and shape how the whole polish sales motion scales.

What's waiting for you:

 * Market ownership: Full responsibility for fonio's sales performance in Poland.

 * Team building: Hire, ramp and coach the polish AE & SDR team as we scale.

 * Player-coach: Lead from the front - stay in deals and demos, not just dashboards.

 * Quota ownership: Clear monthly and yearly targets for the PL market - you?re setting it up for the team.

 * Cross-functional impact: Close collaboration with Marketing, Customer Success and the founders.

 * Build, don't maintain: Shape the Polish sales motion in a fast-scaling startup.

What we offer:

 * €70,000 - 100,000 (base + uncapped commission; depending on experience)

 * On-site in Warsaw (with a 2-month onboarding on-site in Vienna to start)

 * Top equipment of your choice and extremely short decision paths

 * Direct line to the founders and real ownership over an entire market

What you bring:

 * Several years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of closing along a clear funnel

 * First leadership or team-lead experience

 * Strong product and technology understanding

 * Polish at native level and confident, fluent English; German is a strong plus

 * Startup mindset - builder mentality

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro call

 * 60 min Skill Interview with our CCO Alex Brix

 * 20 min Language & Team Fit

 * 20 min Culture Interview

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 UI/UX Designer (m/f/d) Your role

You own how fonio feels on the web. Our website is our most important storefront - and right now it's not where it needs to be. You don't build one nice page, you build a system: a design system and landing page templates that roll out into localized pages across 9+ markets. Continuous optimization, not a one-off redesign. You design and ship - you own the build end-to-end, not a handoff to engineering. We're building an AI operating system for SMBs - people should feel that on the website.

What to expect

 * You own the design and continuous optimization of our website and landing pages

 * You build a scalable design system with reusable components

 * You develop landing page templates that localize across all markets (DACH, FR, IT, ES, UK, PL, US, and more)

 * You design and ship live yourself - full ownership from concept to published page

 * You think in user journey, conversion, and responsive design

 * You work closely with the Creative Director on brand direction

Who we're looking for

 * Several years of experience as a UI/UX or web designer focused on converting websites (portfolio required)

 * You think in systems and components, not individual pages

 * You build and ship yourself

 * Experience with design systems and localization across multiple markets

 * You understand conversion and think in journeys

 * German + good English

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €65,000-€90,000

 * Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 SEO Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You are fonio's in-house SEO lead. Your job: make us rank #1 on Google and in AI search tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) for every relevant query, not just in DACH but internationally. You own strategy and execution, guide the website team on how pages should be structured, and set the direction for keyword research across all markets. We'll work with agencies here and there, but the expertise lives with you.

What to expect

 * Own SEO strategy and execution across all our markets, starting with DACH and expanding internationally

 * Define how pages are built and structured, working closely with the website and engineering teams on technical SEO

 * Lead keyword research and decide how we go after both traditional search and AI-generated results

 * Commission or write the content needed to rank

 * Manage a €20.000-€30.000/month SEO budget

 * Work with external agencies where it makes sense, but hold the strategy yourself

Who We're Looking For

Must-have:

 * You've built SEO at real scale before, full-time. Not "co-owned SEO alongside other things" but SEO as your main job, with results to show for it. Industry (tech, consumer, anything) matters less than the scale you've operated at.

 * International SEO experience, you know how to approach markets beyond your home market

 * Fluent in English and German

Nice-to-have:

 * Strong copywriting skills (an SEO person who can write well is rare and valuable)

 * Hands-on with website tools like Webflow or similar

What We Offer

 * Competitive salary: €65.000-€100.000

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - at our Vienna office, lunch and dinner are on us (plus all the drinks your heart desires, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Head of Finance (m/f/d) Your Role

As Head of Finance, you own the entire finance operation behind one of Europe's fastest-growing companies, across our entities in Europe and the US.

 * Own accounting for all entities: pre-accounting in-house, full ownership of our accounting stack, and the transition to fully in-house accounting in 2027.

 * Run controlling: month-end, quarterly and annual closings, revenue reporting down to the invoice line item, cost and profit center reporting.

 * Own tax: VAT and sales tax, employment tax and contributions, international tax, and transfer pricing between entities.

 * Own cash flow and treasury: planning, forecasting, cash reserves, return optimization, intercompany transfers and FX.

 * Roll out a lean ERP and turn everything manual in finance into workflows and AI agents.

 * Build and lead the finance team, starting with your first hire shortly after you join.

 * Work directly with both founders and the extended leadership team.

What We Offer

 * Up to €130,000 + equity package.

 * On-site in Vienna, relocation package if needed.

 * Real ownership from day one

 * Everything you need to be successful. If you need it, you get it.

What You Bring

 * You were part of building a finance in a fast-growing company, internationally, across different jurisdictions and accounting regulations. (ideally: VC-backed B2B SaaS/Tech)

 * You have run closings and accounting prep yourself, not just reviewed them.

 * You are experienced across controlling, tax, cash flow and treasury.

 * Workflows, agents and automations are your default, not the exception. Claude Code, n8n and similar tools are part of your toolkit.

 * Obsession with detail: small errors bother you before they bother anyone else.

 * Perfect German, very good English.

Hiring process

 * 15 min Intro Call

 * 15 min Intro Call with our Chief of Staff

 * 45 min Skill Interview & Case Study Discussion

 * On-Site Meeting in Vienna

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 People Operations Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You own everything after a candidate signs, from contracts through offboarding, and automate as much of it as possible. We are looking for someone to build the structural backbone to enable rapid scaling.

 * Contracts & onboarding: Manage employment contracts for all employees (direct and indirect employment), organize equipment, accounts, workspaces, and support relocation of international colleagues.

 * HR tooling & automation: introduce and own an HRIS tool, automate workflows across systems.

 * Payroll: Organize and own internal payroll processes, including variable compensation calculation of all sales teams.

 * Compliance & people legal: Support international hiring (EU and non-EU), time-tracking, collective agreements, international taxation topics, etc.

 * Compensation: Manage and monitor compensation bands across teams/countries.

 * Events & culture: Organize internal and external events (hackathons, off-sites, etc.)

 * Offboarding: Manage offboarding of employees.

 * Later, people development: Design feedback cycles, L&D, career development (e.g. SDR academy).

What to Expect

 * Solo, end-to-end ownership of everything people operations.

 * Hands-on operational work to build the foundation for automation/scaling.

 * Direct impact: your work has immediate influence on the culture of fonio.

 * Flat hierarchies: close collaboration across departments.

What You Bring

 * 3+ year of People Ops, HR, or Operations experience, ideally startup or scale-up.

 * Knowledge about Austrian labor law, payroll, and collective agreements

 * Structured, hands-on working style.

 * AI and automation/workflow skills.

 * People-first, low ego. You thrive under intensity.

 * German native, strong English.

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €80,000

 * Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice
